text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking through town on a day off,
when I happen to hear a cheerful voice
calling out from a
Chinese restaurant
down the road.

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
Come on in, folks! Our grand eating
contest is
finally about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Our hungry contestants are once again drooling at the prospect of seizing the throne today!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
Introducing our three-time undefeated
champion,
the Stomach Bulldozer of
Hokkaido, Special
Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
HAHAHA! That's me, the Bulldozer! I
love mapo
rice bowls! OH YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! Trainer, what are you doing
here?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Th-this isn't what it looks like!
This just
sort of...
happened!
choice_data_list: When did you become the champion...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They were, uh, having an eating contest
when I
passed by here a while back...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I got curious, so I signed up and ended
up
winning... And I've sort of been
defending my title
ever since...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I know! But... I'm the reigning
champion! I can't
let people down!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, champion! Show us your stuff
today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Okay! Um.. Hahahahaha! It's chow
time!
YEAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-well, no, actually the restaurant
owner asked
me to come up with a fun
persona, so...
choice_data_list: Aren't you getting pretty into thi...
You're really getting into this, h...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please,
Trainer! Just let me participate in
this one
last time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll step down as champion after today,
promise!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer!
choice_data_list: ...Go out there and make it a glor...
Then, just eat until you're eighty...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Listen up,
fans and foodies! I know this is sudden,
but after today's contest, I will
be stepping down
as champion!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What?! Is she yankin' our chains here?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The champion just spoke
normally!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Which is why today, I'm going to eat like
there's
no tomorrow and leave no room
for regrets!
YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week wins the contest in
spectacular fashion, then steps down
from her position, thus
preserving her
title as undefeated champion.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll do my best to only eat an

appropriately-sized portion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week does her best while
reining in her appetite, but with the
other participants digging
in with such
gusto...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I lost...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's better this way, actually. I
knew I
couldn't keep doing this, but I
didn't feel like I
could stop either...
choice_data_list: That ended up looking like a fixed...
Did that end up looking like a fix...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Besides, my goal is to become the best
racer in all of Japan, not the biggest
eater! Let's get back to
training! OH
YEEEAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might not have the title of champion 
anymore, but it doesn't look like her
high-energy
alter ego is going anywhere
just yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's wrong, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? Why are you talking like
that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okay! YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaha! I-I'm the Stomach
Bulldozer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her pseudonym, Special Week
bulldozes through every dish put in front
of her, and claims
victory as the
champion once more.
